ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio with approximately 90% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels on the fluke surface versus 10% high-intensity (white) pixels localized at the distal tips and specific surface marks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary contiguous dark-intensity blob across the central and medial regions of both lobes. Distinct high-intensity (white) clusters at the far distal tips (left and right). Discrete high-intensity speckling on the left lobe's medial-lateral transition.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an estimated pixel angle of 70-80 degrees and a vertical bounding-box depth approximately 1/4 the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge. Notable jagged indentation on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe near the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the outer edges of both lobes tapering to acute points at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white clusters present at the distal tips of both lobes and along the leading edge of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent, isolated curvilinear (hook-shaped) white pixel disruption located on the medial region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct curvilinear 'hook' scar on the right lobe and irregular nicks/indentations along the trailing edge topography.
other_distinctive_markers: The hook-shaped white mark on the right lobe serves as a highly unique geometric identifier.
